macos.expiry: $.token.expiry as RFC 3339 with fractional seconds and a non-UTC offset
macos.notes: Stored by Go's keyring package: the blob is 'go-keyring-base64:' followed by base64 of the JSON. Raw base64 and plain JSON must decode too.

windows.notes: Go's wincred backend names the generic credential service:user. Fall back to target 'gemini', then to enumerating generic credentials containing both words, newest LastWritten first. The blob is UTF-8 JSON (UTF-16 if written by PowerShell). Credential Manager never prompts, so a failed read is not-found or transient, never a refusal.

linux.notes: The token lives in the session keyring behind org.freedesktop.secrets rather than in a file. Tokendial does not read it yet, so status.platforms declares usage unsupported on Linux rather than reporting needsAuth to someone who is signed in. Sessions do work: they are plain files under ~/.gemini.

endpoints.name: loadCodeAssist
endpoints.notes: Mandatory gate that proves the token; pluginType must be GEMINI. 401 → forget cached credential + needsAuth; 403 → needsAuth; 429 → rateLimited(Retry-After); other non-200 → badResponse. Its body says nothing about usage.

endpoints.name: languageServerQuota
endpoints.notes: Preferred source. The server is launched with --https_server_port 0 and writes nothing down: find the language_server process, read --csrf_token from its command line, list the ports it listens on (two; only one serves this RPC, try all). Self-signed certificate: trust it only for 127.0.0.1, localhost, ::1 on a dedicated client. forceRefresh is essential or the answer is served from the server's cache. Once this source has ever answered, a silent bridge means Antigravity was closed: keep the last percentage stale rather than fall back.

endpoints.name: retrieveUserQuotaSummary
endpoints.notes: Body must be exactly {}. Non-200 is an entitlement gap (a personal account answers 403 'no valid license'), not an error: fall through to the derived count.

sessions.notes: Step statuses all read DONE because a step is written once finished; the transcript's modification time is the only live signal. One busy session at most, never waiting.

status.notice: Talks to Antigravity's own language server and to Google's internal Cloud Code endpoints with the token Antigravity holds.
